Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) City Municipal Council, Koppal Name of Work: Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of Cisco C1121X-8P router, rack system, n etwork switches and fibre cables suitable for KSWAN connectivity, including software AMC, at City Municip al Council, Koppal. A. Technical and Contractual Conditions 1. All equipment and materials shall be new and genuine and shall conform to the approved BOQ and technical specifications. 2. The Cisco router shall be Model C1121X-8P, complete with the necessary power supply, mounting accessories and specified software licences. 3. The contractor shall supply and install the rack, network switches, fibre cables, connectors, patch c ords and other accessories required for KSWAN activation. Any missing or damaged fibre cable nea r the router shall be provided or replaced, as applicable. 4. Network rerouting and configuration shall be carried out in coordination with the designated CMC

officer and the authorised KSWAN technical team. 5. The entire work shall be completed within 60 days from the date of issue of the Purchase Order/W ork Order, subject to site availability and departmental approvals. 6. Equipment warranty and software AMC shall be provided for one year from the date of successful commissioning. Software AMC shall include troubleshooting, configuration support and applicable s oftware updates. 7. At handover, the contractor shall submit equipment details, warranty documents, software licence records and configuration backups. 8. Payment shall be made as per the contract terms after satisfactory installation, testing, commissio ning and departmental acceptance. B. Eligibility Criteria and Service Requirements 1. GST Registration: The bidder shall submit a copy of a valid GST Registration Certificate along wi th the bid. 2. MSME Registration: The bidder shall submit a copy of the MSME Registration Certificate, if appli cable. 3. Non-Blacklisting Declaration: The bidder shall submit a self-declaration on the firm’s letterhead stating that the firm has not been blacklisted by any Government Department, PSU, Local Body, A utonomous Body or Private Organisation during the last three years. 4. ISO Certification: The bidder shall possess a valid ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System C ertification as on the date of bid submission. A copy of the certificate shall be submitted along with the bid. 5. Similar Supply Experience: The bidder shall have successfully supplied network systems or com puter systems during the last three financial years. Copies of Purchase Orders, Work Orders or Co mpletion Certificates shall be submitted as proof. 6. Service Centre Requirement: The bidder shall have an established and operational service cent re within a radius of 50 km from City Municipal Council, Koppal, to provide technical support, maint enance assistance and troubleshooting services. Documentary proof, such as GST Registration, Tra de Licence or Shops and Establishments Registration Certificate showing the service centre addres s, shall be submitted along with the bid. 7. Service Response and Resolution: Any complaint regarding hardware malfunction, repair or ot her technical issues shall be attended to and resolved within 07 (seven) days from the date of com plaint. 8. Delivery and Completion Period: The successful bidder shall complete the supply, installation, testing and commissioning of all equipment within 60 days from the date of issue of the Purchase Order/Work Order, subject to the conditions specified in Clause A.5. .
